name: Crossing at San Felice Scalo
description: Valle Lauro line as a single track with two-track stations, ETCS with the internal supervision: the controlled train runs its usual timetable towards Monte Clanio while a regional service leaves Monte Clanio in the opposite direction; the two trains cross at San Felice Scalo, where the single-track block gives each the section beyond only when the other has arrived.
